protocol.constraint: Raw previous-command encoder columns6:8, gradients and Adam moments remain zero. New belief columns start at zero and train normally.
protocol.change: Only encoder/GRU/head hidden width64 to128. Original64 initial subnetwork is embedded exactly; extra units start behind zero output/cross-to-original weights, with verified initial sequence-output parity and subsequent gradient access. Same complete256 episodes, features, labels, raw-command constraint, loss and6400-step budget.
protocol.controls: Same256 full teacher/current-student episodes and actual features as the H64 trial; same batch8, BPTT64, Adam0.001, clip0.5, seed11 epoch permutations,40 epochs and6400 updates. Wider representation changes optimization and initialization in extra units; success would not isolate capacity from optimization effects. No failed-data filtering or new teacher interventions.
protocol.selection: Exact final40 only. Require5/5 successes AND final holds with zero total safety attempts before the fixed20-case development gate; require>=18/20 successes/holds and zero total safety there. No extension, automatic RL or default promotion.
protocol.scope: Imitation-only controlled width probe, zeroRLupdates; same local-history contract with H128, hypotheticalFOV60 and central-square starts. Not full-goal, final-heldout, multi-training-seed, learned-RL or device acceptance.
